title: statistical-change-detector-for-ci-benchmarking-and-pr-gates
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Add a small, well-instrumented change-detection service in CI that automatically analyzes performance benchmark runs (tokens/sec, p95 latency, and variance) and produces deterministic PR-gate decisions. The service will reduce noise-driven false positives by combining stratified baselines (per-model + seq_len_bucket), non-parametric hypothesis tests, and an EWMA-based control-chart to detect persistent shifts. Outputs: a pass/fail gate for PRs, a short human-readable summary in PR checks with effect size and confidence, and time-series annotations in the performance dashboard for root-cause analysis.
acceptance_criteria:
- CI PR check that fails when statistical detector marks a regression with >= 95% confidence and effect size >= 6% for tokens/sec or p95 latency
- Baseline generation job that maintains per-model and per-sequence-length buckets, updated weekly and anchored to the last 50 stable commits
- Detector exposes clear metrics to Prometheus: detector_alert{model,seq_len_bucket,result}, detector_pvalue, detector_effect_size
- PR check includes a link to a dashboard panel with raw run samples and the statistical test details
- False-positive rate observed in a two-week validation run <= 3% on existing workloads
technical_notes:
- Runner: use existing synthetic-steady-runner v2 with fixed seed + warmup to collect n=8 samples per commit per bucket.
- Statistical tests: use Mann-Whitney U (median shift) and a permutation test for small-n effect size; use Levene's test for variance changes. Combine with EWMA on medians for persistence detection.
- Decision heuristic: require both (a) p-value < 0.05 (after BH correction across buckets) AND (b) relative effect >= 6% OR persistent EWMA drift for 3 consecutive runs.
- Bucketing: model, sequence_length_bucket (0-128,129-512,513-2048), batch_size, hardware_family (A100, H100, CPU).
- Store run artifacts (stdout + perf profile) in s3://redwood-ci-perf/ENG-15432/commit_sha/ and index via metadata JSON.
- Use monotonic commit baseline window: last 50 green merges; fall back to last 14 days if insufficient commits.
plan: 1) Prototype detector as a Lambda-style job that consumes CI-run artifacts and writes results to a small Postgres table (schema: run_id, model, bucket, metric, sample_values, pvalue, effect). 2) Wire PR-gating: GitHub Status check + human-readable summary card. 3) Integrate with perf dashboard: add annotation layer and detector metrics in Grafana. 4) Validation: run for 2 weeks in shadow mode on main branch and collect false-positive/false-negative stats. 5) Iterate thresholds and release gate as optional opt-in for internal repos, then enable by default.
test_plan:
- Shadow mode: run detector on all PRs for 14 days without failing checks; collect labels for TP/FP/TN/FN using manual verification of 200 sampled cases.
- A/B validation: enable hard gate on a small set of infra-only repos for 2 weeks and track developer friction/rollback rate.
- Stress test: simulate burst of noisy CI runs and ensure detector degrades gracefully (no cascading failures); measure detector latency (target <= 2 minutes after benchmark completion).
- Unit tests for statistical modules with synthetic distributions (normal, heavy-tailed, multimodal) to assert correct p-values and effect size calculations.
